faqs.question: What is an AI Customer Service Agent?
faqs.answer: An AI Customer Service Agent is an automated chat assistant that answers customer questions instantly using artificial intelligence. It handles enquiries, provides support and guides users 24/7 using your business content.

faqs.question: How does your AI Customer Service Agent work?
faqs.answer: Our AI agent is trained on your website content, documents and FAQs using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). It answers visitor questions instantly, qualifies leads and supports multilingual conversations. Integration takes one line of code on any website. You control the knowledge base, review conversations and update content as your business evolves.

faqs.question: Can the AI answer questions using our website content?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent indexes your pages, PDFs, service lists and uploaded documents. When a visitor asks a question, it retrieves relevant content and generates a grounded response. You can update the knowledge base anytime.

faqs.question: Is the AI agent multilingual?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent supports multilingual conversations so visitors can get accurate responses in their preferred language. This is valuable for global businesses and UAE teams serving diverse local and international audiences.

faqs.question: Can I integrate the AI into any website?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can integrate it into WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, custom HTML, Laravel, React or Next.js with one line of script. No coding knowledge is required.

faqs.question: Can the AI integrate with WhatsApp or contact options?
faqs.answer: Yes. The AI widget includes contact buttons like WhatsApp, phone, email and social media for seamless customer communication alongside the chat assistant.

faqs.question: How long does setup take?
faqs.answer: Setup takes only a few minutes. Embed the script, provide your content and the AI starts answering. Most businesses are live in under 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Does the AI handle lead capture?
faqs.answer: Yes. During natural conversation, the agent may politely ask for contact details when engagement and intent are high. Visitors can share or keep browsing. Contact details and chat summaries are saved to your admin dashboard for review. Your team follows up on qualified enquiries manually.

faqs.question: How does conversational lead capture work?
faqs.answer: No forced form upfront. During natural chat, the agent may ask for name, email, or phone when engagement and intent are high. Visitors can skip and keep chatting. When they share details, the conversation and contact info are recorded on your dashboard for review.

faqs.question: Do chat enquiries automatically become CRM leads?
faqs.answer: Contact details shared in chat are saved and listed on your dashboard. Your team decides which enquiries to pursue and follow up on.

faqs.question: Is the AI safe and secure to use?
faqs.answer: Yes. The widget uses secure authentication with JWT and domain protection. Conversations are handled with privacy in mind for both your business and your customers.

faqs.question: What makes this different from normal chatbots?
faqs.answer: Traditional chatbots rely on rules or predefined flows. This AI uses advanced understanding, your real business data and natural language processing to give intelligent answers without manual scripting.

faqs.question: Can the AI support ecommerce websites?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can handle product questions, shipping details, order information and more for online stores, helping reduce cart abandonment and support tickets.

faqs.question: Can the AI be customised with my branding?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can customise the branding name, appearance, welcome message and behaviour to match your business identity.
